monthly_fee.description: defaults to the course's default fee

amount.description: bonus/penalty: positive number (a penalty is stored as a deduction); adjustment: signed, non-zero

client_ref.description: your own unique reference; retries with the same value never queue twice

auto_allocate.description: apply to the oldest open charges when no explicit allocations are given

merchant_user_id.description: Click only: merchant_user_id, needed to reverse (refund) payments from nazoratly
merchant_user_id.title: Merchant User Id

secret.description: Payme: the KEY (password for Basic auth). Click: SECRET_KEY. Stored encrypted, never returned
secret.title: Secret

charged.description: tuition and other charges billed for the month (not voided)
charged.title: Charged

expenses.description: operating expenses of the month (not voided)
expenses.title: Expenses

outstanding_now.description: all open receivables right now, any month
outstanding_now.title: Outstanding Now

payroll.description: teacher payroll of the month in status approved or paid
payroll.title: Payroll

revenue.description: payments received during the month (not voided)
revenue.title: Revenue

staff_id.description: membership id of the teacher's login, if any
staff_id.title: Staff Id

org.description: selected center; null when the user belongs to several and none was chosen

release_allocations.title: Release Allocations
